methodology.geometry_digest_derivation: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical compact JSON record of geometry cells, serialized with separators ',' and ':'.
methodology.limitations: Diagnostic timing only; it establishes no performance threshold, optimality, production-readiness, or cross-machine comparison.
methodology.shape_identifier_derivation: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical tagged recursive shape encoding: Terminal is T and OrderedGroup children are G[child0,...,childn].
methodology.timing: median of the per-batch integer nanoseconds per operation; each raw batch duration is floor-divided by iterations, and loop overhead is not subtracted
methodology.warmup: one encode/decode roundtrip per shape before measurement
